name: Egyptian Treasures
description: Step into the world of pharaohs at this immersive exhibition. Replicas of historical artifacts recreate the splendors of Ancient Egypt, offering a fascinating journey for all ages.
longDescription:
"Egyptian Treasures" is an art exhibition presented at the Atkinson Museum, WOW, focusing on the civilization of Ancient Egypt. The exhibition features a collection of replicated historical artifacts, designed to reconstruct the environment and cultural context of the pharaohs and their era. This presentation aims to provide insight into the artistic and historical achievements of one of the world's oldest civilizations.

Visitors to "Egyptian Treasures" can expect an immersive journey through various aspects of Ancient Egyptian life and belief systems. The exhibition is structured to appeal to a broad audience, including families and individuals interested in history and archaeology. The Atkinson Museum, WOW, provides a dedicated space for this temporary installation, running for a week in September.

Admission to "Egyptian Treasures" is ticketed. The Atkinson Museum, WOW, is located in Vila Nova de Gaia, accessible from Porto city centre. It is a short walk from the General Torres metro station, which is served by multiple lines. The venue is generally family-friendly.
